meta.title: Luxury Car Rental in Dubai, Delivered
meta.description: Rent a Lamborghini, Ferrari or Bugatti in Dubai, or a Rolls-Royce with a chauffeur. Delivered to your hotel, villa or DXB. Prices include VAT.

sky.title: Supercars, on arrival
sky.lede: Drive a Lamborghini, Ferrari or Bugatti, or be driven in a Rolls-Royce. We bring it to your door, and nothing is charged before we confirm.
sky.noteBody: You request a specific car, and that is the car that arrives. If it's ever unavailable, you choose a full refund or a comparable car at no extra cost.

tunnel.title: Choose your speed
tunnel.lede: Today's lowest rates, VAT included. Open a card to see every car in it.

supercars.title: Mid-engine, V6 to V12
supercars.body: Lamborghini, Ferrari, McLaren and Maserati, for Jumeirah Beach Road and the climb up Jebel Jais.

suvs.title: Room for four or five
suvs.body: Rolls-Royce, Bentley, Lamborghini, Ferrari and Aston Martin, for family airport runs and the drive to Hatta.

chauffeur.title: The rear seat is yours
chauffeur.body: Airport transfers, weddings and business days in a Rolls-Royce or Bentley, by the hour or the day.

sculpture.title: Compare the specs
sculpture.lede: Choose a car to see its engine, power, acceleration and seats.

reserve.title: Ready when you land
reserve.lede: Choose your dates and where we should meet you, then send the request. {reply}

fleet.title: Every car, every price
fleet.lede: Daily rates include VAT. Each car's page lists its deposit, kilometres and minimum age.

pick.title: Pick a car and dates
pick.body: Choose from {cars} cars and tell us where to bring it: your hotel, your villa or the arrivals hall at DXB or DWC.

request.title: Send a request
request.body: Add your details and where your licence was issued, then send it. Nothing is charged on this website.

confirm.title: We confirm on WhatsApp
confirm.body: {reply} After we confirm, you pay at handover or by secure link.

delivery.title: Delivered across Dubai
delivery.lede: Choose the handover place in your request. Any delivery fee shows in your quote before you send it.

base.title: Our office
base.body: Collect and return at Dubai Silicon Oasis at no charge.

city.title: Anywhere in Dubai
city.body: Free for rentals of {days} days or more, {fee} each way for shorter ones.

airport.title: DXB and DWC
airport.body: Meet-and-greet at arrivals, {fee} each way, airport parking included. We track your flight.

age.q: How old do I need to be?
age.a: {age} or older for most cars, with a full licence held for at least {years} years ({supercarYears} years for supercars). For a Bugatti, you need to be {hyperAge} or older with a licence held for {hyperYears} years. Chauffeur bookings have no age rule for passengers.

deposit.a: Yes. A refundable hold of {from} to {to}, depending on the car, goes on a credit card in the main driver's name at handover. We release it {days} days after you return the car, less any tolls or fines.
deposit.hyper: For a Bugatti, the hold starts at {amount} and is released after {days} days.

airport.q: Can you meet me at the airport?
airport.a: Yes, at DXB or DWC, for {fee} each way including airport parking. Add your flight number to the request and we track the flight, then meet you in the arrivals hall.

included.q: What does the daily rate include?
included.a: VAT, comprehensive insurance and {kmFrom} to {kmTo} km a day (less on the Bugattis). Insurance claims carry an excess, which optional Full Cover lowers. Salik tolls are extra, at the published rate per crossing plus an AED {salik} admin fee.
